# Meals Tracker

> Meals Tracker is a web app for planning daily meals and tracking their nutrition against personal daily needs, using food data from the USDA FoodData Central API.

## Features

- Search foods from the USDA database and add them to breakfast, lunch, dinner or snacks
- Adjust quantities in grams; nutrients are recalculated automatically
- Compare each meal and the whole day against recommended daily intake
- Weekly trend chart of a chosen nutrient against its daily target
- Demo mode with sample data, no account required

## Pages

- [Login](https://meals-tracker--meal-nutrition-e08bf.us-east4.hosted.app/login): sign in, sign up, or open the demo
- [Meal planner](https://meals-tracker--meal-nutrition-e08bf.us-east4.hosted.app/home): plan meals and track nutrition (requires sign-in or demo mode)

## Data source

- [USDA FoodData Central](https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/): nutrient data for every food
